{{Quote|Jaar. Sweetened alcoari milk and vineberry extract. It's too sweet for my taste, but you might like it.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Jarik Solo]]|<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>}}
'''Alcoari milk''' was a liquid that was fermented and combined with [[vineberry]] extract to make [[jaar]], a beverage for [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] children.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|129|Jaar}}</ref>
